_comment: TEMPLATE - copy this file, rename it, and fill in the values from your test. Leave any setting null if unused. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: horizontal_scale in SECONDS (0.002 = 2 ms/div, 2.0 = 2 s/div), vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts (or "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage). sample_rate is derived from record_length + horizontal_scale when null. Enum values: trigger_source "CH1"/"CH2", trigger_slope "RISE"/"FALL", trigger_mode "NORMal"/"AUTO", input_coupling "DC"/"AC". measurement is metadata: "rms"/"delay"/"pulse_width".
